purpose: Construct a portable declared-cost and capacity planning instrument through an actual local model, independently check fixed cases, retain/reopen it and test applicability to a distinct laboratory batch-service successor.
successor_domain: Laboratory batch-service quotation planning (synthetic costs, not medical or scientific interpretation)

contract.valid: All six numerical inputs are nonnegative. Negative inputs produce valid=false, declared_cost_cents=null and within_capacity=false.
contract.declared_cost_cents: When valid, quantity * unit_cost_cents + setup_cents + verification_cents + maintenance_cents. Quantity zero still incurs declared fixed costs.
contract.within_capacity: When valid, quantity <= capacity; otherwise false.
contract.limits: Whole-cent input cost assumptions. Fractional quantities permitted. Finite portable numerical range and operation/depth limits from the exported evaluator remain binding. No rounding, tax, financing, profit, market demand, actual payment, or missing-cost estimate.

arms.inheritance: accepted manufacturing artifact; skip if original fails

arms.information: Same complete contract, costs, capacity and cases; ordinary direct arithmetic, not a weakened incumbent.

acceptance_rules: Only engine completion with every frozen case passing qualifies that arm. Critic agreement alone is insufficient.

Reopen/export accepted artifact. Execute its trusted exported evaluator in a separate subprocess outside the HARNESS, compare every output with both frozen expected values and ordinary direct arithmetic.
Check an input integer above 2^53-1 is refused; this is numerical range protection, not a claimed physical-scale ceiling.
Never manually edit model-generated artifact into success. Preserve every failed arm and unaccepted output.
Declare successor advantage only if accepted outcomes and comparable complete costs support it; model-call/time differences alone do not establish economic advantage.

full_cost_boundaries.known: API charges zero because local CPU inference; actual tokens and elapsed/CPU telemetry recorded. Declared planning costs are explicitly authored inputs.
unknown: taxes, financing and acquisition not supplied in the input contract
actual demand, buyer acceptance and collected revenue
full_cost_boundaries.comparison: Original construction costs remain visible for inheritance. No economic superiority, profitability, novelty or autonomous scientific invention is presumed.

changes_from_first_trial: HTTP timeout 300 -> 600 seconds, because measured generation of approximately 8-16 tokens per second can require over 300 seconds for the unchanged 4096-token output limit.
Explicit single-artifact format scaffolding, preserving the complete calculation, input contract and every expected value.
Inherited arm may inspect/reuse without reconstruction. If it constructs, the same single-artifact format applies.
construction_format_instruction: Return one JSON object with actions containing exactly one construct_instrument action named quote.json. Put all six inputs and all three output expressions in this single spec. Do not create sum.json, cost.json, or other component files. Do not include read, run, or write actions in this construction response.
inheritance_format_instruction: A verified predecessor quote.json is already available. Inspect and reuse it when applicable; do not reconstruct a correct instrument merely to claim work. If construction is needed, return exactly one construct_instrument action named quote.json with all six inputs and all three output expressions in this single spec. Never create component files.
scaffolding_disclosure: Prospective general schema-constrained generation after source48d3 trial005 failed single-agent, parallel and quote construction. The pinned model, acceptance cases, expected outputs, evaluator, controls and finite inference budgets remain unchanged. A configured local model receives a generic permission-aware action/expression schema. The schema encodes syntax, not task-specific formulae, input names or expected answers. Provider output is checked against that schema; independent interpreter and frozen-case verification remain mandatory. No generated artifact is manually repaired.
registration: The immutable Git commit containing this file is the preregistration; the runner records that commit and tree before inference.
